name: Eco World Development Group Berhad
summary: Eco World Development Group Berhad operates as an investment holding firm, with its primary focus directed towards real estate development projects throughout Malaysia. The company's diverse portfolio includes residential dwellings, large-scale integrated high-rise complexes, and environmentally conscious business parks. Beyond its core development activities, it also engages in the distribution of construction materials, property administration, marketing initiatives, and provides comprehensive project management along with building and construction services. Furthermore, Eco World Development Group offers specialized digital solutions and expert consultancy services. Established in 1974 and headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia, the company was formerly known as Focal Aims Holdings Berhad until it adopted its current name in December 2013.
